lines.rom: jaya bhairava deva prabhu jaya bhairava deva sura nara muni saba karate prabhu tumhari seva
tuma papa uddharaka duhkha sindhu taraka bhaktom ke sukhakaraka bhisana vapu dharaka
vahana svana virajata kara trisula dhari mahima amita tumhari jaya jaya bhayahari
tuma bina siva seva saphala nahim hove caturvatika dipaka darsana duhkha khove

pamvom ghumgharu bajata damaru damakavata batukanatha bana balaka jana mana harasavata
